narrative.headline: Smart money is positioning aggressively long in AI/data-center infrastructure — semis, electrical equipment, and communication gear — while rotating out of semi-cap equipment names.
bullish_themes: AI power & electrification trade dominates: Electrical Equipment & Parts is the densest cluster (BE, PLUG, FCEL, AEIS, AMPX, TE) with uniformly 100% bullish flow, signaling conviction on data-center power buildout
Large-cap semiconductor leadership reasserting itself with AVGO ($51M premium) and AMD ($42M) both drawing high-conviction call flow at 92-98% bullish
Communication Equipment showing bifurcated but net-positive bid: CSCO and ONDS bullish, but ASTS rolling bearish
Nuclear/small-modular reactor theme present via SMR in Specialty Industrial Machinery — fits the broader power-demand narrative
notable_individual_flows: AVGO: $51M premium, 98% bullish, 59 ask-side prints — institutional accumulation, not retail noise
AMD: $42M premium with 46 ask-side bullish prints — clean directional bet
BE: $17M premium at 99% bullish — standout single-name conviction in fuel cell / power
MRVL: $23M premium at 72% BEARISH — the largest contra-flow on the board, notable divergence from AVGO/AMD
KLAC & ONTO: 74% and 90% bearish respectively — semi-cap equipment getting actively sold despite AMAT/LRCX showing lean-bullish
narrative.absences: No bullish flow in Farm & Heavy Construction Machinery beyond a lukewarm CAT lean (DE actively bearish), and no meaningful flow appeared in defensive XLI subgroups (aerospace, defense, transports) despite the sector qualifying. The semi-cap equipment split (LRCX/AMAT lean bullish vs KLAC/ONTO/ENTG bearish) suggests no unified bid for the subindustry.
